# Safwan Digital — Mohammed Safwan

> Mohammed Safwan is a digital marketer from Palakkad, Kerala, India, working in digital marketing since 2021. He specialises in B2B and healthcare marketing using Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, AEO and GEO (AI search optimisation). He works full-time with a digital marketing agency in Bangalore (remotely) and takes freelance consultations on the side. He serves businesses across Kerala and India, and brands in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and other GCC countries. He speaks English and Malayalam. YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@safwan.99
